---
title: "Future section"
description: "A section NOT draft, with a future publication date, used to check that the effect of 'not published' cascades to its children although each one has its own date."
date: "2099-01-01"
---
A section with a publication date in the future. It should not be considered
published yet, and neither should its children, although each child keeps its
own date (it does not inherit it from this parent).
